entities.summary: Neolithic Revolution and Early Cities, a transformative movement in Syria (10000 BCE–3000 BCE). Catalyzed Ugarit develops the first alphabetic cuneiform script and Bronze Age Collapse destroys Ugarit and reshapes the ancient Near East.
